name: FY Financial (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: FY Financial (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., founded in 2012 and based in Shenzhen, is a Chinese financial services company with two divisions. The financial and advisory business offers direct finance leasing, sale-leaseback, factoring and advisory services, while the trading business imports and distributes medical equipment in China with maintenance. Its clients include consumer goods, electronics, renewable energy, healthcare, transportation and machinery industries.
